# Tarantuverse

> Husbandry tracker for invertebrate keepers on iOS, Android and the web.
> Keepers log feedings, molts, substrate changes and water for each animal,
> and look up species care guides. Operated by Appalachian Tarantulas, LLC.

## What it tracks
- Tarantulas, scorpions, centipedes, whip spiders, vinegaroons, true spiders
  (including jumping spiders), millipedes, mantises, roaches and isopods
- Feedings, including logging a whole feeding day at once
- Molts, growth measurements, and instar or stage
- Substrate changes and water
- Colonies, tracked as populations with headcounts by life stage
- Breeding: pairings, egg sacs and offspring

## Species care guides
- Index: https://www.tarantuverse.com/species
- Each guide lists temperature, humidity, enclosure sizes by life stage,
  substrate, feeding frequency, temperament and safety notes, with its source.

## Pricing (as listed at https://www.tarantuverse.com/pricing)
- Free: up to 15 animals, 5 photos per animal
- Premium: USD 4.99 per month, USD 44.99 per year, or USD 149.99 one-time lifetime

## Get the app
- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tarantuverse/id6756224640
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tarantuverse.app
- Web: https://www.tarantuverse.com
